techniques.name: Natural-language → formal specification → solver
techniques.goal: Move exact reasoning/search out of the LLM
techniques.mechanism: Translate user intent into formal constraints/program, validate translation, solve with deterministic engine, then render result.

evidence.summary: Evidence basis: SRC-AI-0292, SRC-AI-0293, SRC-AI-0294, SRC-AI-0301.

techniques.agent_os_pattern: Treat formal spec as reviewable artifact with provenance.
avoid_when: Objective/constraints are fundamentally subjective or impossible to formalize
techniques.cost_profile: usually cheaper than repeated LLM search

techniques.name: SAT/SMT offloading
techniques.goal: Guarantee logical/constraint consistency relative to specification
techniques.mechanism: Model emits propositional/first-order/arithmetic constraints; SAT/SMT solver proves satisfiable/unsatisfiable and returns model/core.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: High-value for Agent OS policy/configuration consistency checks.
avoid_when: Semantics cannot be expressed in supported theory

techniques.name: Classical planning / PDDL offloading
techniques.goal: Find feasible or optimal action plans with explicit state transitions
techniques.mechanism: Translate domain/actions/goal into PDDL or equivalent and use search planner.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Potential deterministic backend for Orchestrator DAG planning.
avoid_when: Open world where state/action effects are unknown

techniques.name: Solver-error-guided semantic repair
techniques.goal: Use exact compiler/solver feedback to repair formalization
techniques.mechanism: Feed syntax/type/unsat/error diagnostics back to model to revise only broken specification pieces.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Bound retries and retain every formalization/version.
risks: Model can patch symptom rather than intent

techniques.name: Faithful executable rationale
techniques.goal: Make intermediate explanation causally tied to final answer
techniques.mechanism: Use an executable symbolic/program representation whose execution produces answer rather than free-form chain-of-thought.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Prefer user-visible evidence/artifacts over private rationale.
avoid_when: Natural-language interpretation/explanation is itself the main task
risks: Executable representation can still encode wrong assumptions

techniques.name: Optimization-model extraction
techniques.goal: Turn natural-language resource decisions into an exact mathematical model
techniques.mechanism: Extract sets/parameters/variables/objective/constraints into structured intermediate representation and compile to LP/MIP/NLP/CP solver.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Could support grocery/budget/scheduling modules once objective is explicit.
avoid_when: Preferences cannot be quantified without user values

techniques.name: What-if optimization interface
techniques.goal: Let user explore consequences without manually editing mathematical models
techniques.mechanism: LLM translates question into constrained edits/query against trusted optimization model; solver recomputes scenario; model explains delta.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Keep numeric/proprietary state in solver process, not prompt where possible.
risks: LLM may mutate wrong parameter or misstate solver result

techniques.name: Solver-informed preference/decision support
techniques.goal: Separate hard optimization from human value choices
techniques.mechanism: Compute Pareto/feasible alternatives using solver; model explains tradeoffs and asks only value questions needed to choose among them.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Agent recommends implications, not hidden objective weights.
risks: Model may frame tradeoffs persuasively rather than neutrally

techniques.name: Unsat-core explanation
techniques.goal: Explain why a set of requirements cannot all be true simultaneously
techniques.mechanism: Use SMT/constraint solver unsatisfiable core to identify minimal/conflicting constraint subset; model translates to plain language.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Very useful for 'why can't Agent OS do all of these constraints?'
risks: Core can be non-minimal or implementation-dependent

techniques.name: Invariant/property-based testing
techniques.goal: Test behavioral properties across broad generated input space
techniques.mechanism: Specify invariants and automatically generate/mutate cases; shrink failures to minimal reproducer.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Meta Engine should generate candidate invariants from failures but humans/code own final oracle.

techniques.name: Model checking workflow state machines
techniques.goal: Exhaustively find invalid transition/interleaving states in bounded system model
techniques.mechanism: Specify workflow/auth protocol as state machine and check safety/liveness invariants.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Reserve for high-risk state machines, not ordinary business logic.

techniques.name: Counterexample-guided repair
techniques.goal: Turn formal/test failures directly into focused candidate fixes
techniques.mechanism: When property/model checker finds counterexample, give minimal trace and violated invariant to repairer; rerun checker.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Counterexamples enter failure registry and regression suite.

techniques.name: Black-box Bayesian optimization
techniques.goal: Optimize expensive continuous/mixed hyperparameters with fewer trials
techniques.mechanism: Fit probabilistic surrogate to observed configuration→metric outcomes and choose new trials via acquisition function.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Useful for system knobs after stable eval harness exists.

techniques.name: Successive halving / Hyperband
techniques.goal: Terminate poor candidate configurations early
techniques.mechanism: Evaluate many configs on small budget/subset then allocate more resources to promising configs.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Use cheap sentinel suite first, full protected suite for finalists.
avoid_when: Early metric poorly predicts full result

techniques.name: Population-based search
techniques.goal: Optimize configurations and schedules jointly while retaining diversity
techniques.mechanism: Run population, periodically exploit strong members and mutate hyperparameters/structures.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Conceptually useful for prompt/architecture evolution but needs strict compute budget.

techniques.name: Trial pruning in experiment manager
techniques.goal: Make broad experimentation economical
techniques.mechanism: Central experiment registry supports intermediate reports and prunes trials unlikely to beat baseline.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Part of EXP/EVR registry rather than optimizer-specific ad hoc logic.

techniques.name: Prefix-cache-aware request scheduling
techniques.goal: Increase KV-prefix reuse across replicas
techniques.mechanism: Route requests with shared prefix to same worker/cache while balancing queue load and memory.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Future serving layer can use Agent OS prompt hashes as scheduling hints.
use_when: Future multi-GPU local serving with repeated Agent OS prefixes

techniques.name: API/document retrieval before tool generation
techniques.goal: Reduce hallucinated/stale tool calls
techniques.mechanism: Retrieve current API/tool documentation/schema at tool-call generation time rather than relying only on parametric memory.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Retrieve trusted connector schema, never web docs as executable authority.
avoid_when: Schema already supplied exactly in context

techniques.name: Formal-spec diff review
techniques.goal: Make model-generated formalization auditable before consequential solve/action
techniques.mechanism: Render structured diff: inferred variables/constraints/objective/assumptions vs source requirements; require review based on risk.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: High-risk solver-backed actions require semantic review, not just solver success.

techniques.name: Units/dimensions validation
techniques.goal: Catch common numeric/formulation mistakes deterministically
techniques.mechanism: Attach units to quantities and validate arithmetic/constraints dimensional consistency before solver/model use.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Store normalized unit with structured numeric values.

techniques.name: Range/domain constraint validation
techniques.goal: Prevent impossible values from propagating
techniques.mechanism: Validate numeric bounds, allowed dates, enumerations, cardinality, monotonicity and domain-specific invariants before model/solver actions.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Schema validation + domain predicates.

techniques.name: Optimization sensitivity analysis
techniques.goal: Identify which uncertain assumptions actually matter
techniques.mechanism: Perturb parameters/constraints and measure objective/solution changes; surface high-sensitivity variables for better data/user input.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Feeds proactive question selection: ask only for information that can change decision.
risks: Local sensitivity may miss nonlinear regime changes

techniques.name: Pareto-front generation
techniques.goal: Avoid hiding subjective tradeoffs in one weighted score
techniques.mechanism: Compute nondominated solutions across cost/time/quality/risk objectives and let user choose or provide preferences.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Use clustering/progressive disclosure to show a few representative tradeoffs.
avoid_when: One hard objective with no tradeoff

techniques.name: Constraint relaxation suggestions
techniques.goal: Find smallest changes that make an infeasible request feasible
techniques.mechanism: Use slack variables/soft constraints/unsat analysis to quantify relaxation candidates; model explains tradeoffs.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Policy marks hard constraints that may never be relaxed.
risks: Model may present forbidden constraint as negotiable

techniques.name: Exact database/query execution over model arithmetic
techniques.goal: Avoid asking language model to aggregate/filter structured data mentally
techniques.mechanism: Compile structured question into SQL/dataframe operations and execute; model handles interpretation/explanation.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Prefer query plans + validation over copying thousands of rows into context.

techniques.name: Two-model semantic parser + deterministic solver
techniques.goal: Use cheap model for formalization and strong model only on ambiguous parse failures
techniques.mechanism: First model extracts schema/formal spec; validators/solver detect issues; escalate unresolved semantic ambiguity.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Require source-to-spec coverage checks before trusting successful solve.
risks: Weak parser can create plausible-but-wrong valid spec

techniques.name: Formal assumptions registry
techniques.goal: Make hidden modeling assumptions explicit and revisitable
techniques.mechanism: Every solver/formal model lists assumptions, source/evidence, validity range and review date; changed assumptions invalidate affected results.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Links to Meta-Improvement staleness/research radar.

techniques.name: Proof/certificate retention
techniques.goal: Preserve machine-checkable evidence behind exact decisions
techniques.mechanism: Store solver status, objective, constraint/model hash and available proof/certificate/unsat core with decision record.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Future model can verify rather than trust prose summary.
avoid_when: Solver lacks certificate and decision is low-risk

techniques.name: Formal model versioning + migration
techniques.goal: Keep old decisions reproducible when business rules change
techniques.mechanism: Version variables/constraints/objectives and migration rules; results reference exact model version and input snapshot.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Same principle as prompt/eval versioning.

techniques.name: Solver-first privacy boundary
techniques.goal: Keep sensitive numeric/structured data out of model context when model only needs conclusions/tradeoffs
techniques.mechanism: Run optimization locally over private inputs; expose sanitized deltas, aggregate results or parameter handles to model.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Strong architecture for work/financial Agent OS modules.
avoid_when: Model genuinely needs raw semantic details and policy permits
